description: Chief Secretariate - Southern Province - The orders and Regulations imposed under the Southern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority Statute No. 02 of 1996
categorisation: This gazette primarily contains regulatory amendments to fees and charges for passenger transport services under the Southern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority Statute. It involves legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing orders, fee schedules, and compliance requirements for transport permits and services, without focusing on government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
